items.title: Critical Erlang/OTP Flaw Could Let Hackers Impersonate TLS Servers and Intercept Encrypted Traffic
items.description: A critical Erlang/OTP flaw, CVE-2026-124286 (CVSS 9.1), disclosed on November 24, 2026, allows attackers to impersonate trusted servers and intercept or modify TLS-protected traffic. The flaw affects TLS 1.2 clients, even those with server identity verification enabled, but does not impact TLS 1.3 connections. items.title: Kenya eCitizen Data Breach – Hackers Reportedly Leak Identity Records of 32 Million Kenyans
items.description: Hackers have reportedly begun publishing identity records from Kenya’s eCitizen platform on the dark web. Nation’s review of the leaked eCitizen files found that the attackers had accessed data on 32,128,394 Kenyans. The figure reflects the reported scale of access. It does not mean every record has been published, and Kenyan authorities have not confirmed […] The post Kenya eCitizen Data Breach…

items.title: pCloud Password Manager Hit by Cyber Attack Involving Email Address Exposure and Login Attempts
items.description: Cross-platform password manager pCloud Pass has confirmed it was targeted by a cyber attack after users reported seeing unknown devices being connected to their accounts. items.title: Telegram Warns iPhone Users Are Being Hacked on a Massive Scale; Just Visiting a Website Could Be Enough

items.title: Hackers Set Freezer Controls to 100°C, Then Lock Technicians Out of the System
items.description: Hackers changed a freezer chamber’s temperature setting to 100°C at Salamerija Alpija, a meat processing plant in Tolmin, Slovenia. items.title: 12-Year-Old NFS2ROOT Linux Flaw Let Hackers Take Full Control of Servers Without a Password
items.description: A critical Linux kernel flaw called NFS2ROOT could let an attacker take full control of an unpatched Network File System (NFS) server without logging in. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-99362, affects the Linux kernel’s NFS server when NFSv4.1 or NFSv4.2 is enabled and an attacker can reach TCP port 2049.
